source: NIST CAVP, SHAVS byte-oriented test vectors (CAVS 11.0, generated 2011-03-15), https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/Cryptographic-Algorithm-Validation-Program/documents/shs/shabytetestvectors.zip (SHA-256 of the zip: 929ef80b7b3418aca026643f6f248815913b60e01741a44bba9e118067f4c9b8)
filter: No filtering: every SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256 ShortMsg message is at most 128 bytes (Len 0 … 1024 bits), so all 129 cases of each file are included, copied unchanged; the Len = 0 case's placeholder "Msg = 00" is stored as the empty message.
